sentence: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given us.

source.author: J. R. R. Tolkien
source.detail: 《魔戒》第一部，甘道夫对弗罗多说的话

translation: 我们唯一要决定的，是如何利用被赋予我们的时间。
grammar: 主干是“主语 + is + 表语”：All (we have to decide) + is + what to do...
All we have to decide 是省略了 that 的主语，完整形式是 All (that) we have to decide。all 后接定语从句时关系代词一般用 that，that 在从句里作宾语可省略。这种结构常表示“唯一、仅仅”，如 All you need is love.
what to do 是“疑问词 + 不定式”，整体当名词用，这里作表语，相当于 what we should do。
the time that is given us 是被动结构，主动形式是 give us the time（双宾语）。现代英语更常说 given to us，托尔金的写法更古典庄重。

vocab.collocation: decide to do, decide on sth
vocab.example: We decided to refactor the driver first.

vocab.meaning: 必须、不得不（多指外部要求；must 更偏主观判断）
vocab.example: I have to finish the board bring-up by Friday.

vocab.meaning: 怎么处理、怎么利用某物
vocab.example: I don't know what to do with all this free time.

vocab.meaning: give 的过去分词，被给予的；作介词意为“考虑到”
vocab.example: Given the deadline, we should keep it simple.

note: 小练习：试着用 "All I have to do is..." 造一个和工作有关的句子，比如 All I have to do is fix this one interrupt bug.
